topic: The voice actor who voiced 27 different characters in the same film undetected
hook: He voiced 27 characters in one film. Nobody noticed.
script: He voiced 27 characters in one film. Nobody noticed. Mel Blanc — the voice of Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and virtually every Looney Tunes character — could shift voices so precisely he often voiced every character in a single animated short. In some productions he voiced over 20 distinct characters including background extras. Directors only discovered this when doing re-records. Each voice was so distinct they assumed multiple actors. Follow for voice actors who made the impossible sound effortless.
